name: Kisshouin Yanagi
source:
The protagonist's senior.
Despite being an extremely wealthy lady, she has a kind personality and a soothing personality.
Her good personality and sexy physique make her very popular with the male students.
Although she has received countless confessions, she has never really thought much about romance.

Having studied art since she was a child, she is good at drawing. This is why the protagonist recruited her to join the club.

Yanagi has never had any luck with boys until now, but she is somehow interested in the protagonist.
